title: Replace Flat-Flex Cable (FFC) at the A-axis PCA on a LOTOed tipper station
summary: Replace the flat-flex cable (FFC) connected to the A-axis PCA on a tipper station that has been LOTOed. Use the correct replacement part and ensure the correct left/right ClearLink controller hardware is installed (left/right are not interchangeable due to different IP addresses). The procedure removes the two FFC clamps (four M3 socket-head screws), unplugs/replugs the FFC, then reinstalls the clamps and the station side panel (nine self-tapping securing screws).
when_to_use: Use when you need to restore correct tipper station operation by replacing the flat-flex cable (FFC) connected to the A-axis PCA on a tipper station that is taken out of service via LOTO.
not_for: Do not proceed if you cannot confirm the correct left/right controller hardware for the tipper station (left/right ClearLink controllers are not interchangeable due to different IP addresses).
Do not proceed if the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged cleanly or the clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the LOTO and the physical hardware replacement steps (remove side panel, remove FFC clamps, unplug/plug FFC, reinstall clamps and side panel) using the specified tools and PPE.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
4-mm hex wrench (listed in required tools for the section)
6-mm hex wrench (listed in required tools for the section)
LOTO capability for the tipper (per "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper station is LOTOed before starting the replacement.
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (page 2) referenced by the manual section

visual_references.description: Figure 7-14: Flat-Flex Cable (FFC) showing the A-axis PCA connection, the two FFC clamps, and the four (4) M3 socket-head screws used to secure the clamps.

steps.title: Identify the correct tipper station side/controller to service (left vs right)
steps.purpose: Ensure the correct controller-side hardware is used because left/right ClearLink controllers are not interchangeable due to different IP addresses.
steps.instruction: Before starting the hardware replacement, confirm you are servicing the correct tipper station side/controller (left vs right). Do not assume left/right controller hardware can be swapped.
steps.expected_result: You have confirmed the correct left/right controller hardware for the specific tipper station you are servicing.
steps.healthy_condition: The controller-side hardware for the tipper station matches the correct left/right unit (not interchangeable because IP addresses differ).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm the correct left/right controller hardware for the tipper station.

actions.label: Confirm left/right controller identity
actions.exact_action: Identify the correct tipper station side/controller to service (left vs right ClearLink controllers are not interchangeable because IP addresses differ).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the left/right controller hardware cannot be confirmed as the correct non-interchangeable unit (IP addresses differ).

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper station
steps.purpose: Make the tipper station safe for physical hardware replacement.
steps.instruction: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a LOTO state before any panel removal or cable work begins.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is applied to the tipper prior to accessing the motor and A-axis PCA.
steps.failure_condition: Work begins without LOTO applied to the tipper.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove the station side panel to access the motor (if necessary)
steps.purpose: Provide physical access to the motor area where the A-axis PCA and FFC clamps are located.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: The station side panel is removed and the motor area is accessible.
steps.healthy_condition: Nine (9) self-tapping securing screws are removed and the side panel is off, exposing the motor access area.
steps.failure_condition: The side panel is not removed (or screws are not removed) such that the A-axis PCA area cannot be accessed.

actions.label: Remove side panel screws
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

steps.title: Remove the FFC clamps at the A-axis PCA
steps.purpose: Release the old FFC from the A-axis PCA connection.
steps.instruction: Starting at the A-axis PCA, remove the four (4) M3 socket-head screws holding the two (2) FFC clamps.
steps.expected_result: The four (4) M3 socket-head screws are removed and the two (2) FFC clamps are released.
steps.healthy_condition: The FFC clamps are unfastened at the A-axis PCA (four M3 screws removed) so the FFC can be unplugged.
steps.failure_condition: The clamps cannot be released because the four (4) M3 socket-head screws are not removed or the clamps remain secured.

actions.label: Remove M3 screws securing clamps
actions.exact_action: Starting at the A-axis PCA, remove the four (4) M3 socket-head screws holding the two (2) FFC clamps.

steps.title: Unplug the old FFC
steps.purpose: Remove the defective/old flat-flex cable from the A-axis PCA clamps.
steps.instruction: Unplug the old FFC from the clamps.
steps.expected_result: The old FFC is unplugged from the two FFC clamps.
steps.healthy_condition: The old FFC is fully disconnected from the clamp connection at the A-axis PCA.
steps.failure_condition: The FFC cannot be unplugged cleanly.

actions.label: Unplug old FFC
actions.exact_action: Unplug the old FFC from the clamps.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged cleanly or the clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Plug in the new FFC
steps.purpose: Install the correct replacement flat-flex cable at the A-axis PCA.
steps.instruction: Plug in the new flat-flex cable (FFC).
steps.expected_result: The new FFC is seated into the clamp connection at the A-axis PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: The new FFC is correctly positioned for clamp reinstallation (ready to be secured by the two FFC clamps).
steps.failure_condition: The new FFC cannot be plugged in cleanly or does not seat properly for clamp securing.

actions.label: Install new FFC
actions.exact_action: Plug in the new flat-flex cable (FFC).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged cleanly or the clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Reinstall the FFC clamps and secure with M3 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Secure the new FFC so it remains properly connected at the A-axis PCA.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the FFC clamps and secure them using the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Both FFC clamps are reinstalled and secured using the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: The new FFC is held in place by the two clamps, with all four (4) M3 socket-head screws installed.
steps.failure_condition: The clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.

actions.label: Secure clamps with M3 screws
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the FFC clamps and reinstall the FFC clamps using the M3 socket-head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged cleanly or the clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Reinstall the station side panel
steps.purpose: Restore the station enclosure after the FFC replacement.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the station side panel using the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.
steps.expected_result: The station side panel is reinstalled and secured with nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel is fully fastened (nine self-tapping screws installed) and the station is physically reassembled.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel is not fully secured (missing screws) or cannot be reinstalled.

actions.label: Reinstall side panel
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the station side panel using the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.

success_criteria: New FFC is fully seated and secured by the two FFC clamps using the four M3 socket-head screws at the A-axis PCA.
Station side panel is reinstalled with nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.
Correct left/right controller hardware was used (left/right ClearLink controllers are not interchangeable due to different IP addresses).
healthy_conditions: FFC clamps at the A-axis PCA are secured with all four (4) M3 socket-head screws.
Station side panel is secured with nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.
failure_conditions: Left/right controller hardware cannot be confirmed as correct (IP addresses differ).
FFC clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot confirm the correct left/right controller hardware (not interchangeable due to different IP addresses).
Stop and escalate if the FFC cannot be unplugged/plugged cleanly or if the clamps cannot be resecured with the four (4) M3 socket-head screws.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: FFC clamps, M3 socket-head screws, and the A-axis PCA connection point for the flat-flex cable.
